name: Tubelastica
author: DigiDepot

sections.description:
Tubelastica is a lightweight YouTube embed block for WordPress.

It helps users add a single YouTube video easily in posts, pages, and block-based widget areas. The plugin is designed to work smoothly in narrow sidebar areas, where standard video embeds may cause layout or control issues.

Watch the demo video:
Watch Demo Video

Read the setup guide:
Read the Tubelastica Setup Guide

Features

  • Embed a single YouTube video using a block
  • Lazy loading enabled by default for better performance
  • Optional caption support
  • Width control for post and page content
  • Sidebar-friendly behavior to prevent layout issues
  • Compatible with block-based widget areas
  • Lightweight and fast
  • Custom link option to help keep visitors on your website
sections.installation:
1. Upload the tubelastica folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress
  3. Add the Tubelastica block in the block editor or widget editor
  4. Paste a YouTube URL and optionally add a caption
sections.faq:
Does Tubelastica support sidebars?

Yes. Tubelastica works with block-based widget areas.

Switching from another video plugin?

We recommend testing Tubelastica on a draft post before replacing your existing video plugin. This helps ensure everything displays as expected on your site.

Does Tubelastica work with Blockbase?

Yes. Tubelastica works with Blockbase and other Full Site Editing (FSE) themes.
